title: Epic: gateway hardening against compromise
description: The gateway (RPi + Linux) is the softest target in the LICHEN architecture. While it already operates as a layer-3 IP router (never sees OSCORE-encrypted payloads), a compromised gateway still gets: full metadata (who talks to whom, timing, sizes), topology visibility (RPL state), and routing manipulation capability (DoS). This epic covers three priority mitigations: (1) OSCORE-by-default so gateway compromise yields metadata only, (2) constant-rate cover traffic to hide activity patterns, (3) multi-gateway route validation to detect routing manipulation. Secondary: OS hardening, packet padding, gateway reputation tracking.
